summary.text: Ryan Dotson is a Republican member of the Kentucky House of Representatives representing District 73, serving since 2021.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's profile, Ryan Dotson was born on November 22, 1972, and is self-employed and a senior pastor.
The profile lists U.S. Army service and a U.S. Army certification in radiology, along with service on the Clark County Industrial Development Authority board.
